notes.title: Development Log #15 - Synths, Soul & Sizzle 🎷🎹
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1b2b3e2595969e71b566b9a9f925cfc1e623d2f7.png[/img]

[h1]Hello there, Emperors! 👋[/h1]

Today we’re diving into something that might not be in your recipe book, but it’s just as important - the music. That steady groove you hear while flipping patties or slicing tomatoes? It’s part of the Food Truck Empire.

[h2]Let's start from the beginning[/h2]

Our composer, Marcin, grew up playing tycoon games like Transport Tycoon Deluxe and Theme Hospital - games where the music was as iconic as the gameplay. Back in the day, those games pulled inspiration from jazz, funk, blues, soul, and R&B. But here’s the twist… 

The technology was limited. So instead of fully recorded tracks, you got MIDI compositions interpreted by your sound card - making every track a little bit funky, a little bit synthetic, and completely unforgettable.

[b]That’s the flavor we’re channeling in Food Truck Empire[/b].

[previewyoutube=0bKRZmqLzUg;full][/previewyoutube]

From plasticky pianos and too-shiny brass to synthetic bass guitars and stiff drum kits - our goal was to recreate the slightly “off” but totally charming sound of that era. Marcin was using FM synthesis, old ROMplers, and quirky sound fonts to bring that retro-futuristic vibe to life. 

The result? A soundtrack that feels like it could live inside a '90s sound card… But somehow still grooves perfectly with a modern-day food truck empire.

[h2]Cooking in rhythm[/h2]

Of course, it wasn’t all smooth mixing and instant hits. The first version of the soundtrack was written before we even had a playable build. And once we started testing the game, we realized… It was a bit too catchy. With so much going on in the music, it was hard to focus on outfitting your truck or planning the perfect menu.

[previewyoutube=imTXw1KRWXk;full][/previewyoutube]

So, Marcin went back to the kitchen. He softened the sharp edges, reworked arrangements, and toned down the energy - while keeping that signature flavor intact. A lot of the tracks changed completely. And even though the instruments were “simple”, mixing them turned out to be a complex process. 

Bringing together dozens of different sources - each with their own quirks - meant hours spent adjusting reverb, cleaning up harsh frequencies, and finding just the right balance so nothing felt out of place.

[h2]Meaning of sounds[/h2]

But most importantly, music in FTE is a part of the game’s identity. As Marcin says, “it’s not just about matching the aesthetic - it’s about adding something new, something memorable, something that makes the world of the game feel just a bit more alive”.

[previewyoutube=YgFCM0RITe0;full][/previewyoutube]

Now here’s a question for you - what kind of music would you love to hear in the game? Maybe a street jazz band for one of the cities? Some lo-fi beats for late-night cooking shifts? Or how about a synthwave twist for a neon-lit food truck dream? Let us know - the kitchen (and studio) is always open.

Food never sounded so good. 🎧

[b]Stay tasty, Emperors! [/b]

notes.title: Food Truck Empire joins The Days of Ramadan Festival! 🌙
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Emperors! 🍔[/h2]
[i][h3]We're thrilled to announce that we've joined The Days of Ramadan Festival! 🚚[/h3][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b646b037aef2d389d8122b12db9f9b0acf549849.png[/img]

At first we thought - “A game about food at a festival centered around fasting? That’s quite the contrast"! But the more we considered it, the more we realized how much food plays a role in bringing people together - especially during Ramadan - when meals like Iftar and Suhoor are moments of connection, tradition and community for so many families.

While our game is about running a food truck business, it’s also about the joy of sharing meals and creating something people love at its heart. We’re honored to be part of this festival and to celebrate the cultural and culinary traditions that make food so meaningful beyond just eating. Quite literally, joining this festival is a food for thoughts for all of us and brings us additional perspective which we cannot be more thankful for. 

To those observing Ramadan - we wish you a peaceful and fulfilling month! And to all our players, we’d love to hear your thoughts - what dishes inspired by Ramadan and its traditions would you love to see in Food Truck Empire? Let us know! 🙏

And since we're talking about community - you might want to [b]join us on our Discord - just click the image below![/b]

notes.title: Development Log #14 - Neighborhood takeover! 🌆
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b04f3509c3323b8f017cb532243014c326f2959c.png[/img]

[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]

The city streets are bustling with opportunity, and we’re here to introduce you to a brand-new feature that will make your journey to Food Truck dominance even more engaging. 

[h2][b]Say hello to our new revamped and refreshed Neighborhoods![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/faebf0578b3d53f3e70d5c3644ce4c4857ae7b8e.png[/img]

You may be asking - what are neighborhoods? Aren't those the places where customers live? You already have seen some parts of the neighborhoods when you were playing through our demo, however what we are doing now is giving them a much more important role. Let's start with the basics!

[b]Neighborhoods are clusters of city blocks that players can "conquer" - they all share a certain pool of Fame that you can gain.[/b] Think of them as mini-territories within the sprawling urban landscape, each with its own challenges and rewards.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/0408109d000fffc458a7805c1f9b31e67105fb0c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


Your primary goal? [b]Build your influence within these neighborhoods by serving customers on their streets and growing your reputation[/b]. Gain enough Control, and you'll [b]unlock special perks and opportunities[/b] to solidify your empire!

Every neighborhood is made up of designated road segments - streets where your Food Trucks can operate and maintain their business. By serving the customers on a street belonging to a certain neighborhood you'll be able to increase your Control over that neighborhood. Now... This all seems very nice but what exactly will that Control give you? 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/bd2d0628820071f5df0728e0de48e4515775f04c.png[/img]


[b]Gaining Control influences the neighborhoods in two major ways:[/b] 

1. By leveling up your Control you can gain access to unique quests that are available for that particular place. These quests can give you great benefits that will make it easier for you to conquer the rest of the city. 

2. The higher level of Control over the neighborhood, the less Fame you'll be able to get out of them (and remember you need fame to research new projects and enhance your food trucks). At this point people pretty much start seeing you everywhere, even when they simply open up their fridge! 

[i]Keep in mind that some streets will lay on the border between two different neighborhoods! In these cases, Fame and Control are shared between all affected neighborhoods. Fame multipliers are averaged, and Control gains are divided.
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e9b1261d2b922a297224f6a92b89204d1ed51351.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]

[i]Clicking on the street will also provide you with information about how many people from different demographics tend to traverse through them - it will definitely prove to be helpful information![/i]

Now you're probably wondering - what happens when you gain total Control over the neighborhood? 

[b]When you max out the Control over a particular neighborhood several changes happen all at once:[/b]

1. Neighborhoods control no longer decays over time. The neighborhood is now fully stabilized under your rule.
2. You earn a global Fame bonus - this boosts your reputation across the whole city giving you a passive bonus to all Fame income across the level. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/704b1378a95f5ea4f0af5fbb47ca84c5e0f8824c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


[b]Take a look at the Neighborhood Inspector visible above.[/b] By clicking any block within a neighborhood this little window will open, giving you a detailed overview of the area. 

[b]Name[/b]: Every neighborhood needs a name, right?
[i]Speaking of which - [b][url=www.lichthund.com/discord]Join our Discord[/url][/b] if you want to name some of the areas yourself as we’re currently gathering all ideas for their names![/i]
[b]Control Progress Bar[/b]: Showcasing the current level of your control over this place.
[b]Demographics[/b]: A summary highlighting all customer demographics and how big is their population in this area. 
[b]Quests[/b]: Some neighborhoods will have unique quests tied to them - with an enticing reward! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e12473e060aa2943e5bb627a8beb3df068b643b0.png[/img]

[b]Neighborhood quests are a completely new way for us to give you additional goals[/b] to work for while adding a new layer of strategy and narrative. Don't be surprised to find some very unique and interesting quests in your neighborhoods! 

However [b]in order to get a quest you will first have to unlock it and you will do so by reaching the first level of Control in that particular neighborhood[/b]. You need to invest in the area in order to potentially reap benefits but you will always be able to first see what kind of rewards await you there and then decide whether you want to invest your time. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/65b622977eeec865db7f40bfb92229323c047e70.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


[h2][b]What do you think about the new Neighborhoods? [/b][/h2]

[b]The Neighborhood system transforms the city into a living, breathing entity that reacts to your actions - no matter whether you aim for total Control, maximize Fame bonuses, or chase quest rewards.[/b] What is more, our aim is to implement more flair and add additional flavor to the city - having separate neighborhoods with their own story, image and feel should make the area so much fun to explore! 

Keep in mind, as always, that this system is a work in progress, and we’ll continue refining it. However we’re confident that Neighborhoods will add a whole new flavor to your experience. 🍔

[h1]Happy New Year! [/h1]

[b]As this might be the last of our devlogs this year[/b] we'd also like to take a second to wish you all great holidays and fantastic Happy New Year! 

We're going to enter the year of 2025 with renewed energy and even more ideas and fun features that you might hope for - just watch us ride this truck! 

Have a great time everyone!

notes.title: Development Log #13 - Cookbook to the rescue! 🥕🥓🧀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/ae471fa37d98042524dc1af022203c81eb4c72d9.png[/img]

[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]

There are many ingredients that you can use to create all kinds of meals in your food truck. Consequently there are many different cooking processes that your ingredients can undergo resulting in many, so many, different variations of food you can create. It's no wonder that sometimes even the smartest and wisest food truck entrepreneur can get lost in it - but we're saying “stop” to that.  

[h2][b]Let's introduce a new feature that we're working on![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1a76b2dfd950a2a38c9bdd5e9640280bcb500872.png[/img]

[b]First of all let's explain what a cookbook actually is[/b] - it's your handy companion, a favorite book of all aspiring entrepreneurs, that should make all your cooking much easier. Cookbook lists all ingredients that you have an access to and showcases what cooking process they can go through together with ([u]if you've ever attempted to do so before[/u]) the result of how that process will transform the ingredient. This means that every time you want to do something interesting with the ingredients available in your truck, you can simply open up the cookbook tab and check what are your options and possibilities. 

Take a look at the easy example below.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/3a6c15d8d57db1ec4861b8a4b4ce8681d83a428c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


The screen you see above is just a part of the cookbook focusing on a certain ingredient - in this case Meat Patty, which is outlined by the yellow circle. Now, usually the names of the ingredients or processes show up only after you move your cursor over them but to simplify the picture we're including relevant tooltips in the screenshot. 

[b]Every ingredient that you look up in the cookbook will highlight all the processes it can go through as well as the processes that preceded its creation[/b] (if those exist!). In the case of Meat Patty, you can quickly see that this particular ingredient can go through several different processes (including highlighted Grilling), and that it was created through Hand Prep from a different ingredient. 

Now, I'm pretty sure you have also noticed the question mark icons, so let's talk about that. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/6ddcdca76cb4da277d35a8dab9fc842db95dba3c.png[/img]

Cooking is often a process linked with discovery. You can also make all kinds of decisions regarding your ingredients - sometimes you will end up with something great, sometimes it will be absolutely inedible. [b]You can discover different blends and mix tastes together to create something tasty.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b92552a1a393b32527964159bfadfa09ed0d69bc.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


[b]Cookbook will accurately track your actions within your trucks.[/b] Whenever you start using a new ingredient or work with a new cooking process you will receive a notification about the discovery you've made. [b]Uncovering a new ingredient will result in it being then firmly placed within your cookbook for you to see it at any point in time. [/b]

However, if you haven't yet tried to combine certain ingredients with a particular cooking process, the cookbook will display a question mark icon, signifying that this particular outcome has not yet been discovered. [b]You will need to either research that particular ingredient, so it becomes available in your truck, or experiment with your cooking processes to discover what ingredient will be created through your actions. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/881372d18401172af6e9d5165402d9f9d9f75262.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


As soon as the ingredient is discovered the question mark icon in the cookbook will be replaced with the relevant ingredient icon and you will now be able to see all the processes that are connected to it. 

It's satisfying to find the right combinations of ingredients and processes, but it's also fun to go into it unknowingly - it all depends on your own approach, but we've got you covered on all sides! The cookbook will always remain at your disposal to ensure that you're never left without a helpful companion. Ultimately, whether you rely on your memory or this new feature will be, of course, your choice.

Okay, so how do I reach the cookbook? How do I navigate it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/367ad4a83016189380c3b31ff1626a7c89c6a5d8.png[/img]

[h2][b]You can reach cookbook in two ways:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Simply click on the blue Cookbook icon that will be available in the UI bar at the bottom of your screen[/b][/h3]
This action will be available to you on most screens within the game and it will open the cookbook. Then you will be able to select what meal you want to create and what ingredient you want to learn more about. 

The extra step regarding choosing your meal is an important one - the cooking “system” we’re currently actively developing is going to be complex and it’s entirely possible that some ingredients will have different cooking processes and results depending on the meals you've decided to create. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f85f1711db859bd66c3d8d83459bc07ad9361e32.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


[h3][b]While in the food creation screen simply hover over the ingredient (either placed in truck or in the side menu) you're interested in and press "C"[/b][/h3]

This will bring the cookbook on your screen. However, this time it will automatically open up on the ingredient that you previously hovered your mouse upon. This way you'll be able to quickly navigate through the pages of the cookbook and efficiently find all the recipes you might be thinking about. All you need to do is to just hover and press "C". 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5ec52e7e4765071d381ed45f30b217a1d4e92c73.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/08591d40c6161948324341a9706ea203ae3bdf48.png[/img]


[h2][b]What do you think about the Cookbook? [/b][/h2]
Keep in mind that the art you're seeing right now is not the final version of it, and we'll be still working on its visual and functional side. We do however think that our Cookbook will help you explore what sort of tasty or kooky recipes you can whip up in the Food Truck Empire! 🙌

notes.notes:
[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]
[h3]🍲Play Food Truck Empire DEMO on Steam now![/h3]

The Cooking Festival is almost at its end, but we're here to tell you more about our game before that happens! We'd also like to thank you everyone for playing Food Truck Empire during the Cooking Fest - we had a lot of fun interacting with you and listening to your feedback, which we'll now take to our dev roundtable, where we discuss everything Food Truck Empire-related! 

Today we'll focus on the city and customers - we'll tell you a bit about our plans for the future too, so hopefully you'll get excited together with us! 

[b]Let's jump into it! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f697002a80b22e7f68c3ed894f0ba6cceec6ffd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/22d69d8297252c752c1315e0393111fa4d571836.png[/img]

The city is alive with the sound of hungry customers - we're here to make sure those turn from hungry rumblings to joyous declamations of satisfied happiness! 

During Cooking Fest you had the chance to play a bit in one of the cities we're planning to include in the full version of our game, but as you probably already deduced, and, as our steampage proudly displays, we're working on several cities for you to enjoy and conquer with your culinary prowess. 

The main point of the game is to feed the hungry masses and make the city yours - at least when it comes to food. Cities are going to be ripe with all kinds of bigger and smaller events that will influence the way you play the game. Those events can pertain to pretty much anything happening in the city - perhaps there is a festival and there are a lot more tourists within the city for next two weeks; perhaps most of the children went away with their parents for vacations and you have to deal with creating a holiday-themed menu for the remaining citizens and so on.

We have a lot of ideas for the cities - some are the usual mainstays you would expect, but some are quite quirky. We want to make them feel unique not just by appearance, but also by inclusion of unique customer groups or new events. What’s more - we're working hard on making sure that each of the levels you will be able to play through the game will sport a distinct look that will make it aesthetically pleasant to play through!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e1beb517ae236b490b0770ad72d8c69c231c207c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/61dc60fd98ea6cfc5c6762160ac744c93da48060.png[/img]

The customers are, of course, of highest importance for all Food Truck Emperors. Depending on their approval of your food you will see a glowing success or a sore defeat. You will have to adapt to clients’ meal preferences and always have your head open for researching new solutions to cover the wants of as many customers as possible at the same time. 

New cities mean that customers might change too - or at least their preferences. Don't get hoaxed into thinking that one solution will work across several cities - proper research should always precede the action! 

It might get complicated - a group you might remember from the first city could have a new variant introduced, with much more challenging preferences... Groups might have up to 5-6 preferences at the beginning but more than 10 later on. The preferences also come in two categories - likes and dislikes. And of course, what one group loves, the second might passionately despise. 

Hopefully you're ready for the tastiest of all adventures!

notes.title: Mini Cooking Fest Dev Log #2 - About pipelines and ingredients!
notes.notes:
[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]
[h3]🍔 Play Food Truck Empire DEMO right now on Steam![/h3]

It's another beautiful day of Cooking Fest! What did you eat today? Have you taken part in our contest? Make sure to check out our Social Media to learn more about it and participate!  

Today we'll talk about our pipelines and ingredients you can use during your cooking endeavors and why sometimes your food might turn out a bit... interesting! 

[b]Let's jump into it! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/3d39d4c13889cc6c37dec8e96c32c2f75bbb1717.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e59714eda5a332932976b217a06397cf50a1e0e8.png[/img]

What is a dish pipeline - you might ask. And it's a great question, the most important question!

Pipeline is the way you design how work happens within your food truck. It's the cool and fun lines you might have seen within the food truck on our streams or on screenshots; lines that start at the basic ingredients and slowly go through many different phases and inventory pieces. Those lines symbolize the road that your food takes before it's fully processed and ready to be ingested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/dfebacc15885076aee310f6df3b3363c1d450f34.gif[/img]

Now - depending on those lines several things will happen but there are two that we want to highlight here: 

[list]
[*] Your food will receive the flavor score - a numerical value that signifies how tasty your dish turns out to be.
[*] The overall speed of production will be calculated - generally the quicker you are with your dishes the better. 
[/list]
You have limited space in your food truck and you need to organize it properly. You can drop and move the elements of your inventory wherever you want in the food truck (but the serving counter needs to be by the serving window!) to organize your pipeline however you see fit. Sometimes you will have to sacrifice some speed to make sure you have more flavor. Sometimes you will do the exact opposite to appease the customers with a short fuse. It's up to you to find the best possible connections! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b03de70105e5544264b8781ead8f59abd26a242a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/c6758a3f365e655c4839905e92bc18915dcb14c2.png[/img]

There's a lot of ingredients at your disposal too. And you will quickly notice that a certain choice will always be yours to make - do you want to make your dish from scratch or will you rely on pre-prepared variants of the components of your dish? 

Wanting to create the dish from basics generally yields more quality and flavor! However, you have to go through many more steps in order to create it and, as you've already read before, more steps equals longer pipeline, and that means that your serving speed will suffer a hit. Sometimes that won't be a problem as your customers have different patience thresholds, but it's good to remember about it. 

We can't wait to see what will be your strategy - will you create an amazing dish consisting of high quality handmade ingredients, or will you cater to those who want a culinary quick fix right now? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/bf73466e9c934a82aec684ebf43e97d78d8c29d6.png[/img]

notes.title: Mini Cooking Fest Dev Log #1 - About reviews and food parks!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]

We hope you're enjoying yourself with our demo! Today we wanted to talk a bit about our reviewing system and about the food parks - share some light on our philosophy behind it but also give you the platform to talk about your feelings regarding those two systems. Let me start by saying that if you have any opinion on them whatsoever we invite you to let us know about your feelings in the comments to this dev log. We'll be happy to discuss and talk with ya! 

[b]Let's jump into it! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/ef4dd378a18782c346f6a0e477c07ac6cbd38869.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/652ef1275dcc8952c200e58a11929ee6486a7b1b.png[/img]

Designing a reviewing system that is both balanced, fun and adequately challenging isn't an easy thing. We should know - we went through multiple redesigns from the ground up for that particular system and many many changes regarding how it should work in the game - if you joined us previously during some of our playtests you might even still remember some of the older ideas we had. 

However, ultimately, we obviously landed on one unifying idea - the system needs to be immediately understandable for our players. The game needs to be fun! This might seem obvious but in reality, when you have a head full of different ideas and interesting notions, keeping the system simple and fun can be a challenging ordeal. Our current system should embody the main design points - fun, simplicity and clarity and we worked really hard on making sure that each of those points are present within the game.  

Simple should not however mean [i]too simple[/i]. The challenges presented to you in the Food Truck Empire will slowly get bigger but at the same time more satisfying. We want to ensure that you will always have the right amount of freedom within your cozy little food truck - freedom to create amazing dishes as you see them fit while also juggling different ideas on how to sate your customers. 

We have based our newest system on the simple idea - each ingredient has its own tags and some of our demographics will like that tag (thus giving you a higher score) or dislike it (and lowering your final score for your review). It’s simple and elegant, and it works very naturally while still leaving us a lot of creative space for interesting ideas and challenges!

[url=lichthund.com/Devlog12]You might want to read more about the specifics of our reviewing system right here![/url]

Let us know in the comments what you think about our reviews system - we are always open for implementing further improvements within our systems! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/ea91b7f18c9230a3760f50d92629f76d559e3db7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a699508523394476091f135caba1bb64efee1c95.png[/img]

Let's talk about Food Truck Parks now! 

During the development of Food Truck Empire we had an idea for specific places on the map that will boost the capabilities of your food truck. Well, technically yours and your competitors (coming in full version of the game!) but let's focus on you specifically. We wanted to give you some extra options when it came to strategy as we strongly believe that the more options you have, the more fun you will experience. A little touch of strategizing will also add to the overall experience! 

When you're managing your trucks you're given a seemingly simple choice - either scout the city and find the right place to park your truck and capitalize on the citizens in vicinity OR use food truck parks to try and extend the area of effect for your trucks. The catch being - food parks are stationary objects and posting your truck inside them forever will mean that you're limiting yourself to a certain area. In a way you'd be sacrificing your mobility for extended range of influence. 

Food Parks evolve over time through their individual quest lines. It's a fun little addition to reward those of players who like to see some incremental changes and additions to the way they're playing the game. While you can still use some of your trucks to target several other areas in the city that your parks do not cover, some of the trucks can be used to generate steady income while gradually enhancing the park to some legendary status. 

What's your strategy when it comes to Food Truck Parks? Are you solely relying on them or do you prefer to individually approach each truck and each part of the city?

notes.title: Development Log #12 - New Reviewing system! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
notes.notes:
[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]

We all know that reviews are very important for any business venture that wants to become successful - after all without them there's no way your Food Truck will ever become famous! As that is the case we've worked extra hard on making sure that our reviewing system is extra clear and intuitive and today we'll talk a little bit about how that system works and the eternal struggle of balancing and fun that stems from it!  

[b]Let's jump into it![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4d3448442fb54fd9fc8703698f89032f97d72e99.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/8b486dabed74f51cbc2c58ec913db83f89dbe35f.png[/img]

As you might know we've been extensively playtesting our game throughout the last few months. If you ever asked yourself why the short answer to that question is because we believe that through your feedback we can grasp the very best idea for how our game should tackle all kinds of ideas that pop inside our heads. Throughout the playtests we've been also checking with you on the state of the reviewing system available in the game - the way the customers behave after eating your burgers and the scores you receive informing you about the quality of the burgers you've created and how your customers liked them. 

It is through playtesting that we've discovered and understood that we need to find the right balance between relaxing gameplay, fun and cozy feeling of the game and the level of challenge presented within the game. How hard should it be to create the right burger? Short answer is "just enough to keep you entertained but not enough to make you annoyed". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a549d4d12f4b2235d792f3cf5790b54389db1141.png[/img]

And as such we've embarked upon a journey of finding the right reviewing system that concluded with finding just the right system that encompasses ease of access, understanding and fun we've strived to achieve. 

Do you know that we used to have hearts to symbolize culinary preferences of our customers? It was, however, a bit too complicated - you aimed at having ingredients with the most numbers of heart but then the number was multiplied by some other factors and yadda yadda yadda - it was way too much for a simple and fun system! 

After several discussions and feedback sessions with our community we decided on something different - a simple and elegant way of having stars be the main hero of our reviews. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e496bbbd5c68ec3b5d7adccb6e72b17ed8a7dff8.png[/img]

Now when you'll play through the game you will notice that each of the client demographics available in the game have their culinary preferences neatly presented with a short but sweet information on how your star score will change if you decide to use them. Simple, right? 

Let's take a look at tourists, for example, one of the demographics that are available in our game - just by looking at their demographic tab you will immediately see that they'd prefer to eat fruits or sea food and they really dislike vegetables. You don't have to spend too much time analyzing complicated graphs - one glance is enough to more or less understand the tastes of that particular demographic. Now you can enter your truck and craft the recipe that's gonna work exactly for them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/0c9fc4bdfa2dcaa85f3b1eba834bbdbe1bd9f454.png[/img]

Our new system is also better at supporting strategists who'd prefer to minmax their trucks to offer meals that could potentially be of interest to several groups of customers. When no math is involved aside from counting the stars (and yes, you can say [i]we'll be counting stars[/i] 🎵in this game!) it gets easier and simpler to check out whether the dish you're currently working on might also work on several other categories. Not to mention that you can always simply check the dish and see how it compares across all clients in the city at any time! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/24755ed6cd6158fb85149e77651b8517daca9bf9.png[/img]

There are all kinds of things that can impact the number of stars you will get. Each ingredient has several tags that your customers might be looking for but that's not all. The processes your food will undergo can also influence the score. The overall flavor of the dish will often be more important for some people than some actual ingredients. And of course - the speed of meal preparation can also be taken into account - you've got your work cut out for you! Or... you'll cut it out yourself in the truck! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/13b4bf80152903b443411d3ed46cc7d3fedbe951.gif[/img]

All ingredients can only hold up to 4 tags at the same time - sometimes you will however notice that there are ingredients who have only 2 or 3 tags present! That's a great opportunity to add some tags via all kinds of cooking processes! They have their own tags and products that undergo the particular process will receive the tags coming from the process. Even the ingredients who already got 4 tags are not exempt from this mechanic - they will however lose some of the tags they used to have before the process happened.

notes.title: Development Log #11 - Customizing your food truck! 🎨
notes.notes:
[h2] Hello there, Emperors!👋 [/h2]
Phew, the last few weeks were super busy for us all at Lichthund - day by day we've been introducing bigger and smaller changes, we've hosted two Open Playtests and we've been to a bunch of different cool events! We haven't even had time to have a proper sit-down with y'all and talk about customization that you might have already checked out during playtests! 

[b]Let's fix that! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/24ef2f382605cb2591176358522584a9f0568111.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/194bba1348904502110ecc6fb70221788250b0cb.png[/img]

[b]What's one of the most important things regarding building a brand?[/b] Making sure that you look the part! Customization was one of the tools that you've demanded the most and for a good reason - it's always nice to drive a truck looking just the way you want it to look or be able to change the look when you get bored of it. Customization was one of the priorities for our team and believe me when I say that we've spent many chats and discussions about the direction we want to take with it. Currently we're happy to say that [b]our customization tool should indeed allow you to create trucks full of personality[/b] resonating with your own unique personal style! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/d76252a7f7a27ac62f05356e4b295d64fc3fb614.png[/img]

[b]Truck is on display, you know what to do[/b] - start clicking everywhere and see what kind of visual makeover can you give to your mobile work station! We've categorized the options you have at your disposal into several categories - trust me you'll want to go into each of them and change some things. 

[u]Take a look at the list of options available in the truck customization:[/u]
[list]
[*]Parts
[*]Roof Props
[*]Trim
[*]Accessories
[*]Colors
[*]Decals
[*]Drawing[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5addb5de71341c897a1b0cd6bcd251e6927bad59.png[/img]

Your first steps will probably be all about changing the overall shape of your truck. We're giving you several options in that regard and you'll be mostly interested in "Parts", "Roof" and "Trim". Those three options will let you change some of the shapes of your truck. Imagine yourself walking through a dark alleyway and suddenly seeing a truck's dark silhouette... don't worry, trucks don't rob people but they do offer tasty food! Anyway - that particular silhouette will look differently depending on your choices made right in these three tabs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/6b09edc7db33277444fc3b450818d265de2770fc.gif[/img]

We have several options awaiting you in the tabs - and as we are still working on the game and the changes you might expect them to change in numbers and possible options. I'm particularly proud of the roof options - they are very distinct and easily identifiable so your food truck will be recognizable even from a larger distance! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/7c535c4a9c39e941dd1f68880f4e3b1283247bc6.png[/img]

Accessories will let you add some extra elements to the walls of your truck. A single sleek speaker to let everyone audibly know that you're driving nearby? A handy neon-lights to illuminate the night and transform your truck into a beacon of hope for all hungry midnight-dwelling partygoers? Browse, select and use them as you see fit! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/09c989ca126b5b100ec83d694cb5e797a08e4a96.png[/img]

Keep in mind that accessories' colours can also be modified to better suit your chosen truck theme. Experiment with them to find the right look for your truck! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/824a18b87090387ac88de37724977d165dcf3c9b.png[/img]

Last but definitely not least we've got options related to colours - painting, drawing, decals and stickers! Colors can easily influence the atmosphere and mood of your customers - and we know that we all have our own favorites when it comes to them. Through these options you'll be able to enhance the overall mood of the truck and the vibe it gives off. 

We do however know that sometimes too much is not good - that's why when it comes to painting we're giving you the option to choose whether you want to stick to an easier, less complicated choice and select the overall color pattern/use simple color scheme edition options or dive into deep and tackle advanced color scheme editing options. Just keep in mind that we're using the word "advance" for a good reason - you'll literally be able to edit tens out of tens of different parts of your truck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/351ba6dc4ba44b0e0f4e1e3d9be6f329819b8245.gif[/img]

Decals and stickers will add something extra to the visuals of your truck - we've created several super cute stickers that you can freely use on many parts of your truck. I absolutely adore them but I wonder which one of those showcased before do you like the most? 

Also - for those of you who are artistically inclined we also included the option to directly paint on the truck. We know, we know, it's risky business, you can after all literally draw ANYTHING and we know what that means but just do remember that customers will also be able to see your creations! 😂

[h3]How do you like our customization options?[/h3] 
Make sure to let us know your opinion in the comments! If you think our customization lacks some specific options or maybe if you'd like to see something specific included - head to the comments and let us know!

notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 10 - Headquarters 🏢🚚
notes.notes:
[h3] How's it hanging, Emperors?!👋 [/h3]
We’ve been talking at length about our customers, our food truck fleets, our food - but what about the backbone of our empire, our Headquarters? It is time to discuss how to best utilise your HQ to expand your food truck empire. 🏢🚚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4f63d6d046772ce69ea4025f784665d807912de7.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/18c95830e14f2a0de2a5c4e217786870ba1d2b8d.png[/img]
When you first jump into the game, you are presented with a vast world to conquer with your food trucks… but that’s pretty difficult to do without your fleet, isn’t it? That’s why you need to construct a building for your Head Quarters! This is your main hub of operations, so choose your location wisely. Here, you will be able not only to buy and customize your trucks but also to research new technologies and permits to grow your empire. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9c7e1b73dcb7cfc5ae180b5b62fa01258fd4b3be.gif[/img]

This is the heart of your empire - when not spending time serving customers around the city, you will most likely be expanding your food truck fleet and researching new technologies. Let’s discuss how to use each floor in your Headquarters in more detail. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4389c8246f656fa715ace1e5cc1ee9017ce328f3.png[/img]
Ground floor - this is where the management works, eats and only sometimes sleeps. As a start, it’s just a literal blank space ready for your expansion. As the first order of business, you need your own Executive Office where you can get permits concerning general food service. For example, unlocking access to food parks, getting more parking space in your Basement or increasing the capacities of recipes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/3d8b54bb7805bfa328f2cda7b2f399ff92aeda79.gif[/img]

After a while, you will have enough money and fame to expand your business and add a Research & Development branch. This will allow you to upgrade the interiors of food trucks with better technology and appliances. Sharper knives? Oh yeah. Some new meat? Yummy. A microwave? Fine, I guess. All in all, the ground floor of your HQ is the brains of the operation, but what about the wheels? For that, we have to get down to the basement…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/6bd3da579d3abae20dabe4f5edebfd0cfefe0507.png[/img]
Basement time! This is where our food trucks get their good night's sleep - at least we hope so. Just like with the ground floor, there won’t be much here at the beginning, but once you start rolling in dough, you will get more and more opportunities to expand your food truck fleet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f48abe4d51fbebe2b7fc197aa173b93f5ecc2a14.gif[/img]

You can buy new trucks, customize the existing ones both inside and out, and send them to town from here. It’s important to expand your basement as much as your ground floor as not to fall behind and have enough trucks to serve mostly everyone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[h3]So that’s all on Headquarters for now[/h3] 
If you’re hungry for more info on[b] Food Truck Empire[/b] or have any questions regarding this post - let us know below in the comments.

notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 9 - Meet Your Customers (part 2.) 🧓🛹🪩
notes.notes:
[h3] Welcome, Emperors 👋 [/h3]
It’s about time to introduce you to more of Food Truck Empire’s many customers! You’ve met Normies, Kids and Blue Collars already. So, let’s go to the next big 3 - Elders, Teenagers, and Partygoers!🧓🛹🪩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a9a5ad187d6a342121609fb462540eecc9ee9fa4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/d7dc43726899ba3e5c651e72cb5a25053d6391ec.png[/img]
Elders are the oldest customer group in the game which comes with its own pros and cons. First of all, it can be hard to cater to their needs exactly. They don’t want to experiment as much as other demographics and they like to stick to the basics. Also, they prefer to eat their healthy veggies rather than the fatty meat patties. But, most of them are retired already and have a lot of free time to roam around the city. You can be there to provide for them in that time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/69393d244b2f323138c4d97b9b37ef1005fcf8a4.gif[/img]

Elders shouldn’t be overlooked, because Boulderville has a lot of them naturally and they have money to spend. You just have to adapt accordingly to their needs while playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/c3dc1451c8fd09b1af7d64fc039a1a14bbdb2e2d.png[/img]
We mentioned Kids in one of our previous posts, but we didn't mention what happens when one of those Kids actually grows up! Introducing: (drumroll) [u][b]Teenagers, THEY DISLIKE EVERYTHING. [/b][/u]If you thought Kids were picky eaters well then… good luck catering to Teenagers. You have to be very particular where you serve them and what you serve them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/8ccacd65117f23172962d7eedcf5cdf75f240dd1.gif[/img]

It’s not that hard to include them in your empire expansion plans! All they care about is getting their food fast, and that's something you can do, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/207ed506fce22765b26a2916c879ebe73bd8734f.png[/img]
[b]Partygoers are the social backbone of Boulderville’s nightlife.[/b] Sometimes you may mistake them for vampires seeing how late they come out of their caves just to party hard and disappear in the morning. Their top priority? Getting wasted and grabbing a quick bite while at it. No need for exquisite dishes or elaborate compositions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a554941dc2adf587a09ef29ebbe17bea3737f702.gif[/img]

Partygoers, however, are localized in the places where the partying is happening. You have to drive around at night to cater to most of them, so you have to adapt your strategy accordingly

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 8 - Sunny Side Avenue ☀️☀️☀️
notes.notes:
[h3] G’day, Emperors! 👋 [/h3]
We have explored the first district of Boulderville - namely Clark’s Valley - quite a while ago, so we think it’s about time to go back and check what’s happening in the West City! 🧐

[h1]☀️ Welcome to Sunny Side Avenue ☀️
[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/2197277ace09ede7be74c27dabeea34b19db5de9.png[/img]
[h3]It’s always sunny in Phi- I mean Sunny Side Avenue!  ☀️[/h3]
Sunny Side Avenue is the West District of Boulderville. Compared to Clark’s Valley, it’s much busier and bustling with shopping malls, cultural institutions, and more. That means a bigger challenge for your food truck fleet but also many opportunities for business growth. 💸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9a8f7af8bb6f78ef8d2c68ca6ecfb40c2dd9c0c2.png[/img]

The overall size may not seem that bigger than Clark’s Valley, but when it comes to specific important city structures… yeah, [b]Sunny Side Avenue is [u]THE [/u]place for business[/b], so let’s take a closer look at the specific noteworthy places in this district! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e6f04dca31fce3c377254bf44a37846bb816e876.png[/img]
[h3]Every delicious dish needs to be served in a beautifully crafted dish! 🏺[/h3]
National Pottery Museum of Boulderville is the place of appreciation for all things pottery - vases, pots, plates, cutlery - you name it!  Tourists, though, can get pretty hungry after such an extensive intellectual visit, so [b]you have to be there to provide them with a quick bite afterwards. [/b]😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/d1cccb5294c4e1844720fee593f9480ba57df3c3.png[/img]

National Pottery Museum is a vital point of the cultural life of both Boulderville and Sunny Side Avenue. [b]Don’t overlook this location when planning your food truck empire’s expansion![/b] 🤠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/3b324412b8929f31aeb4fdb9db3414137cb19493.png[/img]
[h3]You want to reach the heights of relaxation? Then book Haven Heights! 🏨[/h3]
Tagline aside, Haven Heights Hotel is [u][b]THE [/b][/u]place to stay at if you have the money for it. It is the most luxurious location in whole Boulderville with a lot of rooms and other amenities. T[b]he crowd your truck will be serving here is mostly wealthy and elder individuals who are ready to wait a little bit more and pay a little bit more for an exquisite dish. 🍝 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/fd8332110adb03d8c877682057d14ea001254b53.png[/img]

The particular tastes of hotel’s premium customers would probably your biggest challenge if you want to serve customers around the grounds. [u][b]Are you up for it?! 😤 [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9bb22c01a89b4bd6e82170a15f137b09f1e8db08.png[/img]
[h3]No, it’s sadly not a big boulder-turned-shopping mall… 🪨[/h3]
On a more serious note, [b]you OBVIOUSLY want to take advantage of the masses that visit the Boulder Mall every day for their shopping needs.[/b] If they are spending money in the Mall, then why wouldn’t they want to pay for some delicious street food either?! [b]Besides that, it’s also a lively social hub for teenagers and young adults alike who are also looking for a cheap bite. 🍔[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/99fe12ebdc9ade4f4293e37d4e177d8fa4f15b0f.png[/img]

The Mall attracts all types of people during different time periods. You have to adapt accordingly, especially when it comes to [b]the Rush Hour - you wouldn’t want to miss serving a ton of customers during that time, would you now?![/b] 🏃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/69229fef84a59de2951d2a86d7391d4124a9a9eb.png[/img]
[h3]The name is kind of self-explanatory, no need to go further… 🤪 [/h3]
Okay, okay - Serenity Park is the quietest place in Sunny Side Avenue with spaces for both chill and sport activities. In both of these cases, your food truck fleet can be there to deliver both great snacks and after work-out meals. [b]It’s also yet another social hub of the area, so stay on track and see what’s happening in the neighborhood to take advantage of those crowds. 🌲[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/aece5aba53429004f3c559688c9c8d227a21803c.png[/img]

Also, if you ever feel overwhelmed because of building your food truck empire, [b]you can just come here and chill out for yourself - it ain’t illegal or anything, nobody gonna inspect you, so go ahead and get some chill time, you really deserve it. 😇 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4121aa4af5ebb7512a2a0e13562d4c6da54b514a.png[/img]
[h3]Don’t have enough money for Haven Heights? Sunset got you covered! 😎 [/h3]
A lot of tourists don’t have the budget to book a room at a standard hotel or rent a lodge in Clark’s Valley. [b]That’s where Sunset Motel comes into play - the oldest accommodation in Boulderville [strike][i](and it shows)[/i][/strike]! 😏 [/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/215844dd8b1722ad159be1b32f8a90966f33e7fd.png[/img]

Logically speaking, people staying in such motels wouldn't be interested in exquisite cuisine or very expensive experiences - [b]so your food truck fleet has to adapt accordingly to their needs and also time schedules.[/b] Most of them are out of their small rooms during the day, so you have to plan accordingly! 🚚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/483b950a65109fdb942e0d29e7daf0cd2d0fc319.png[/img]
[h3]What’s more radical than some sick ramps, m8? 🛹[/h3]
This is the place if you want to feel the youth radiating from the teenagers spending their free time on the skatepark. R[b]adical Ramps is the only place like that for them, so if you want to include them in your business expansion strategy, then this is the place to go. ☝️[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5ef8a9e944266ed973967b7a11360e1b00c31f02.png[/img]

Though this place is not [u]ONLY[/u] for teenagers - [b]this is one of the quieter sides of Sunny Side Avenue, so you are bound to find some people looking for chill time, so you can serve those customers on the way as well. 🍟 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e83644bbda00a316ef94a82e3c4eda14e0fe6c47.png[/img]
[h3]What is this?! Another Mall??? 😱[/h3]
Since the city is dynamically growing, there came a need for yet another mall. For now, it still will be some time until it opens, but it doesn’t mean you can’t use this to your advantage. [b]There are plenty of hungry workers who are looking for a cheap bite during their lunch break. 👷[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9341f020540035487e7d27be626d42eadcaf5aaa.png[/img]

This mall is yet under construction, so the name isn’t set in stone. [b]Maybe you have some ideas for an amazing name? [u]Let us know in the comments for sure - we would love to hear from you! ✍️[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/07d13eb6ae00d4a2c31f8514d9a2233b35d677c4.png[/img]
[h3]🚨Breaking news! 🚨[/h3]
There has been an outbreak of food flu in the small town of Boulderville. The main suspect behind such a sudden disease appearance seems to be your competitor, [u][b]Food on Wheels™[/b][/u]. Luckily, the local Boulderville Hospital employs the best of the best doctors and nurses, so the affected are in good hands health-wise, but… [u][i]the food there is really terrible[/i][/u]. [b]So, that’s where you come in! Serve those hungry and tired customers with the best street food of their lives [/b]- [i]just be sure to check your food before any accidents happen… 🤢[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9ca0bc6c2e567bc7cc845c19c472a12a6c088001.png[/img]

In all seriousness - the Boulderville Hospital is a good spot to start building your street food empire. By serving food to those in dire need of good cuisine, [b]you bring prosperity to both your business and the region. Don’t sleep on this location! 😁 [/b]

notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 7 - Food Parks Empire 🤠🚚
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Top of the morning, Emperors! 🫡[/b][/h3]
You know what’s one feature that we keep showcasing in the screenshots but haven’t talked in depth yet? If you have guessed Head Quarters… then not yet. 

[h3]For now, let’s tackle the Food Parks and what makes them an invaluable resource for building your Food Truck Empire![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b6dd4eef2a4f53a16af2d44af0e0d15f01c9979a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/fa27d0a3212df4c1c18b2582072b1bf18ecd719c.png[/img]

Food Parks, [i]or Food Courts if you are fancy,[/i] are essentially a place for more than one food truck to serve customers. [b]People come to you and your food trucks rather than the other way around.[/b] That makes it simpler to bring stable profit without having to worry about route optimization. Each Food Park has their range (which can be upgraded with level-ups), which covers some area around the park itself, so people from nearby streets will know where to go to when hungry. 🍽️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/806f5dbc0cae569ad4c6d8e9046b696697189e83.gif[/img]

[b]Food Parks also can be leveled up to bring even more profits to your empire! [/b]Once you complete a particular task on one food park, it will [b]upgrade while bringing you more profits along the way. [/b]Those tasks can vary - for example, serving 75 burgers in 1 day, getting 3+ star reviews from one type of customers or simply serving 100 dishes - and we are still experimenting and testing to get the balance just right. 👌


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/bf50f76b5b5a80b6d462b13055b2de8837ebdde6.png[/img]

Alright, once you decide to start utilizing food parks, y[b]ou will want to obviously upgrade them! [/b]For now, we have 3 different levels of Food Parks with different requirements, perks and visual changes attached to them. [u]Let’s get through them. [/u]

[h3]LEVEL 0[/h3]
Well… I don’t know what you expected -[b] it’s not built yet! [/b]You will be able to find some Food Parks around town to use on Level 1 though, so you don’t have to create your own from the very beginning.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/7e15e122a434ba1a4c51efe108b0f4c477a46a08.png[/img]

[h3]At [b]Level 1,[/b] have a small range and only 2 spots for parking your food trucks. Also some toilets for your customers.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/10ad54adc17a03d0bb425e34eff766daf59a299f.png[/img]

[h3]At [b]Level 2[/b], you get extended range and an additional spot to park another food truck. Also, more benches for people to sit and blankets on top of that. [i]And… one more toilet…[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f297fe68b181c36d2cb71b4f78665540da33e940.png[/img]

[h3]At [b]Level 3,[/b] you get even more range and yet another additional parking spot. Now you have a real spot for people to hang out no matter the weather. There is even a special… [i]toilet building?[/i] [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e60d08001d53e9afda7ecc6ab66c07700f576055.png[/img]

[b]As you can see, upgrading those foodparks is a must if you want to expand your Food Truck Empire further.[/b] Also, to make it more understandable how much range these Food Parks have - here is a handy GIF to showcase just that. 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4447ae2dc5ea31a768a64b17bcf3ff0934ab392c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/db3614dcb2ca805ac239825bb3d0adc305682788.png[/img]

[b]You know what food parks are, but why in the Hell’s Kitchen would you be using them instead of normal street spots?! [/b]Well, they just make your job of overseeing your food truck fleet very trivial. Instead of having to look around town for the most profitable locations, clients go to you. 💸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/efb608bc2d701e3fb6441c04e6ac08082bd83cfd.gif[/img]

However, since your food park cannot move as freely as your fleet does, [b]you get a limited choice of customers and overall less control of who you are serving your dishes to.[/b] It’s ultimately your decision - [u][i]to use food parks or not: that is the question…[/i][/u] 🤔


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]
[h3][b]We hope you understand Food Parks a lot better now! 😊 [/b][/h3]

You know a lot, [u][b]really A LOT[/b][/u], about the intricate mechanics behind the core gameplay of [b]Food Truck Empire[/b]. 🤓

[u]But what about the people that make the world of our game so interesting and varied?[/u] Time to talk about the possible customers you get to meet throughout your culinary journeys. [b]First up, Normies, Kids and Blue Collars![/b]  👨‍👩‍👦👷

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/602ec16c7eb0572fc93b52da4be3780b06fa0998.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4b5c0584c3c3e9f63242c27d68fde78b655f9b31.png[/img]

notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, Emperors! 👑[/b][/h3]
Last time on [b]Features Buffet[/b] we showcased some of the best ways to set up your food trucks’ interior for optimal taste, speed and profit! Today we’d love to talk a little bit about how [b]TIME OF DAY[/b] works in [b]Food Truck Empire[/b] and how it affects gameplay. ⌛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/d1b15f76618296af4a8c2c741de6c5660f82c9c2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e5f7a3387cff8ac2a607f50e4c30717858d76c52.png[/img]

A day in [b]Food Truck Empire[/b] consists of [b]3 different time periods[/b], each with its own distinct vibe and look.
[h3]🌅 [b]Morning[/b] - [i]5:00 AM - 12:00 PM[/i]
☀️[b] Afternoon[/b] -[i] 12:00 PM - 7:00 PM[/i]
🌇 [b]Night [/b]- [i]7:00 PM - 2:00 AM[/i] [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a159767b185b945a275a4a22f09deff187e00b72.gif[/img]

[b]We wanted to make sure that with lighting and other effects we can make them as distinct as possible while also keeping the overall character of the game consistent. [/b] We’ll share more on how we achieved such a lighting system in a separate post soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/180b030766b23c296405d26cf3dc781cbd25fdb0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/15af55475a4cc4ae0c8518450f3bf9386bf8b5f7.png[/img]

[b]But time of day is not just about looks, it plays a pivotal role in our cities’ lives. 🏙️ [/b]

As you already know, we have a lot of different types of (potential) food truck customers inhabiting our game. [b]Each of them has their own behaviors depending on the time of day.[/b] Early in the morning, the streets will be full of commuters, kids on their way to school, and workers getting ready for a hard day of good old manual labor. 👷

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/542b53d84a2cc5ba71bcf714388000dd11b3b46b.gif[/img]

[b]If you want to cater to a specific demographic, you have to get to know their schedule.[/b] Afternoons might be a better time for tourists or elders just casually strolling through town. And nighttime? Nighttime is party time, so be on the lookout for a lot of hipsters and partygoers eager to burn the midnight oil and eat some burgers. You can try serving food to elders at midnight, [i]maybe it ain’t the most sound business strategy[/i] - [u][b]but you do you! [/b][/u]🤠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5c805ab7a41ec3d9421895ed54a020001c806402.png[/img]

Ok, so now for the last piece of the puzzle. You know all about demographics, and you know that different times of day affect how the city and its inhabitants behave, so [b]it’s time for EVENTS.[/b] 😁

Events are… well, [b]events that happen during specific hours throughout the game. [/b]Some of them might be regular, like lunchtime in the downtown business district, and some might be dynamic, like a game happening at a local stadium. ⚽

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b6b905bc81712e63e085a4bad47d56a4b75e2d69.gif[/img]

[b]Each of them presents an opportunity and a challenge.[/b] It pays to always be prepared and agile with planning your fleet and menu. [u]You never know when that extra food truck might come in handy![/u] 🚚

notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 4 - Optimizing Potential & Flavor 🍔⭐
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Welcome, Emperors! 👑[/b][/h3]
Some time ago for [b]Features Buffet [/b]we went through equipment inside the food truck needed for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1872970/view/4170972198114087091?l=english]building your empire in the SPCU order[/url]. 

Now, it’s time for some more [b]in-depth explanations of the systems and mechanics of Food Truck Empire concerning the cooking pipeline and its optimization[/b]. Knowledge of hydraulics is not mandatory. Let’s go! 🤠

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5a6dd69129e19e60883b126b8a0efe190a60c568.png[/img]

In [b]Food Truck Empire[/b], your food is judged by the world’s worst critic -[u][b] the hungry public[/b][/u]. 🙃
Many aspects are taken into account when measuring how successful your food truck is in the eyes of the crowd, like [b]Preparation time, Potential of ingredients or the overall Flavor of the food[/b].

To improve your review scores, you need to start using [b]better ingredients and more equipment[/b].. You can’t build an empire on premade patties and bought baked goods. These are great for at the beginning, don’t get us wrong -[b] but you will have to sooner or later implement some changes to your layout. [/b]🚚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1039addeec51273f8835f9941fa2f7a4584f3261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a0b36aa48f426d9412910137dae1e8607dcba345.png[/img]

Every ingredient in [b]Food Truck Empire[/b] has an inherent value of [b] Potential[/b]. To keep it brief, [u] [b]it's all about what can you do with a particular ingredients and how many steps of Preparation you include. [/b][/u]🔪

[b]Some ingredients can go through a lot of different steps, while others have only 1 or 2. [/b]For example, [b]Premade Patties[/b] have low Potential. Once you upgrade to [b]Processed Meat[/b] which is higher in Potential, you can add a Manual Preparation step that can make the Quality of the overall dish better in the long run.  ⭐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/c7fd9695b3682aea8ef43d3d19f27e7d88cf1e08.gif[/img]

For the sake of this explanation, let's use the highest Potential ingredients when it comes to Burgers so Raw Meat pieces. They have the same value as a Premade Patties, so 1, [b]until you process the Meat to a form of Processed Meat. [/b]You can finish here with 2 slots of Potential, b[b]ut you can go even further and then form proper patties from that meat.[/b] By doing this, [b]your Potential jumped from 2 to 3.[/b] ☝️

However, you can just as well get the Raw Meat and slap it on the grill. Would it be then better than the Premade Patty?[u] Well, not really.[/u]🙃 
That's why upgrading your food truck interior with new equipment is as important as getting new ingredients. But, as in a lot of systems in [b]Food Truck Empire[/b], how you approach the potential of the ingredients is entirely up to you. [b]Do you want to get Michelin Stars and prepare all your ingredients from scratch or would you rather just stick with Frozen and Premade ingredients Fast Food style?[/b] 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1039addeec51273f8835f9941fa2f7a4584f3261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/89905d339a4eedece0fe94817070a2e6cbfbd8d1.png[/img]

The next important value is the [b]Flavor [/b]of the dish you are serving to customers. [b]Cooking and seasoning brings Flavor to whatever you are serving,[/b] but it is very heavily reliant on [b]the ingredients' Potential and Preparation steps.[/b] 

[u][b]The value of Flavor is based on how many Potential slots your Ingredients have. [/b][/u] As described above, some Ingredients have more Potential than others, but that doesn't mean you have to fully make use of that potential.  😎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/c5bf72af7b432d4a334e35c6152f12b7db1664ae.gif[/img]

[b]For example, grilling can give you up to +3 Flavor if your ingredient's potential matches that number. [/b]So if you are using only Premade Patties, your Flavor will only be 1 no matter how good your equipment or seasoning gets, because the initial Potential is too low for the +3 from the Grill to matter. If you prepare Raw Meat to the Processed Meat stage only, then it will only ever have 2 Flavor, even though Raw Meat itself can be brought to up to 3 Potential. 🤓

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1039addeec51273f8835f9941fa2f7a4584f3261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e32010068df851ed7f17d38ff3c0e4b6eb04d253.png[/img]

When it comes to serving your customers, [b]the food’s quality matters a lot but it is not the only vital component to raving reviews[/b]. [u][b]You also have to provide great service on time[/b][/u]. Ambitious dishes matter little when people have to wait outside your truck for 15 minutes to eat. In contrast, when food is provided very fast, [b]your review score can improve significantly even if your dishes are mediocre at best. 😅 [/b]

[b]Every consumer is different, that’s obvious.[/b] Some eat meat, some don’t - some are lactose intolerant, and some love cheese more than anything in the world. You have to figure out what each demographic group like and understand their preferences, usual routes and schedules. [i]Selling Steaks to Kids at 10 PM near the stadium isn’t the smartest idea. [/i]🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/60eeaf7d8fd94f92341dbf71b43b849a1f1e2477.gif[/img]

So, plan your food truck’s kitchen accordingly [b]to make the dishes not only delicious to your chosen demographic but also deliverable in a timely manner.[/b] Maybe seasoning BOTH the bun and meat isn’t that important or people don’t care if you use presliced cheese. Those decisions are a constant challenge to overcome in [b]Food Truck Empire.[/b] 🚚👑

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/1039addeec51273f8835f9941fa2f7a4584f3261.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/4dc87ae6117cf4bc6dd25bad19ed7c6fc29b2867.png[/img]

[b]The pipeline class session is over and you are ready to put that knowledge into good use. [/b]Let’s go through 3 examples of equipped food truck’s kitchen and see what can be fixed or improved in them. [i]For the sake of clarity, we will be using burgers in every truck below.[/i]🍔
[h3][b]🔸 [u]Case 1.[/u] 🔸[/b][/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/380c5f9190dbf8a6d1beca8aa9e4757c19e2ec44.png[/img]
Alright, our first contender and... [b]we are not off to a great start.[/b] 😬
Do you see what’s wrong here, Emperor? Besides… [u][b]everything[/b][/u]. [i]Well, maybe the serving counter is in the correct place, I will give them that.[/i] First of all, there is not a single piece of Manual Preparation involved except cutting the bun in two. Moreover, the pieces of furniture are too far from each other making the whole process a lot slower. [b]Let’s try to fix it a little, shall we?[/b] 💪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/25f49e0be67f80af8db71cc147ef432f3954cb8e.png[/img][b]See, better already! [/b]🤗
We improved the quality of the food overall by changing premade patties with Processed meat. That added one more step to the preparation, as we needed to add a Working station, but it overall boosted our score with customers. Then we also changed the layout of the whole truck, literally keeping only the Serving Counter where it was, to make the process of cooking much faster. 

[h3][b]🔸 [u]Case 2.[/u] 🔸[/b] [/h3]
Okay, the previous one was a warm-up. [b]Are you ready for something more challenging, Emperor?[/b] 🧐
This time, someone wanted to create a delicious Fish Burger with freshly baked Buns. [i]We wonder what can be improved here…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/fa2a92f9a2ef2eb227204339644d4f06478b8333.png[/img]
Alright, alright - this one is better already - [b]at least you don’t have to run around the truck like a headless chicken![/b] 🐔
[i]However, there are still some issues.[/i] To begin with, creating bread from scratch sounds awesome, but is not optimal for this type of dish. Do you really need to create your own dough for it as well? And also, the bun itself has so many steps involved while the Fish is premade and then just reheated in an Adventure Oven (hip name for a microwave). Let’s see how to improve it…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/a76dcac92d038b49b940ab49e5b6a1210fba22f1.png[/img]
✨[b]This looks exquisite! [/b]✨
By exchanging some of the preparation steps from bread to fish, the quality of the food itself has improved while also maintaining a better potential for the buns. The fish is not premade and you have to do some prep work to bring its Potential further. Through optimization of both operations, this food truck now works much better and provides better service than before.[b] Great job! [/b]👍

[h3][b]🔸 [u]Case 3.[/u] 🔸[/b][/h3]
[b]Alright, 2 down, 1 more to go![/b][i] Let’s take a look at the last screenshot of a mobile kitchen.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/8d3a965f5414bfbfddc987e2276a4aed9862cfb8.png[/img]
We’re stumped - is there [b][u] anything [/u] [/b]to improve? 🤨
Maybe you could try creating your own buns, but that ain’t a deal-breaker as you already have 3 ingredients involved in the preparation and space in the food truck is really limited. [b]Do you see anything that can be improved here?[/b] We believe it’s fantastischly optimized already... [i]or is it?[/i]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/5a6dd69129e19e60883b126b8a0efe190a60c568.png[/img]

[h3] [b]The inside optimization of the truck ain’t so hard after all![/b]🙌 [/h3]
The most important lesson from this post is that [b]ingredients' Potential is unleashed through Preparation while forms of Cooking brings Flavor.[/b] With both the prior knowledge of equipment and now the pipeline optimization skills, you will build a successful Empire in no time. notes.title: Features Buffet vol. 3 - Exploring Clark's Valley! 🚚🗺️
notes.notes:
[h1] Hallo, Emperors! 👋 [/h1]
Last time around for Features Buffet we went through equipment inside the food truck needed for building your empire in the SPCU order. Now, it’s time to explore the first city at your disposal - [u][b] the quaint Boulderville[/b][/u]! Your food matters a lot, sure, but without knowing your surroundings, you will be running around like a headless chicken. Don’t worry -[b] we’re here to help you! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/05c970cda8002024d42b1bbf64148a06cfcf570a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/ed16b1b51663193b67feec2abd699aed2d1846af.png[/img]
The first available place for you is the [b]Boulderville’s East District called Clark’s Valley[/b]. You will be able to progress through the game and build outposts to expand your influence, but you have to start somewhere. [b]Clark’s Valley may look tame and quiet at first, especially in comparison to the bustling West District, but it has a lot of lively landmarks with hungry customers.[/b] We will be going through each of the districts to show you what type of people spend time there and how to best utilize it in your business expansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b6f8faefa614500079bb66b04242ebcd88a4bfd6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/c220df451ed14f7b64b7fef1d5f1d2696948d160.png[/img]
It’s only fitting to start our journey through the town with the Boulderville Train Station. This is the main hub of transportation in the city, so obviously you can find a lot of Tourists coming in and usual residents leaving for trips and vacations, Normies in particular. This is a perfect opportunity to serve great food to people about to start or end their journey. Of course, in such a spot, timely service matters much more than the quality, so [b]you have to adapt your mobile kitchen accordingly. 
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/cd0c55ee7fb762f99c40f1dc8c6d57deb3e1feb5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/876708ba377b31e8b9540398c35ececa373eba06.png[/img]
We move on to the place where most of the Tourists stay to enjoy the serene atmosphere of Boulderville, so the [b]Quiet Cove Tourist Lodges[/b] and their surroundings. Some places of note here are the surrounding shops and the smaller basketball court. Tourists are usually up and about exploring the city and the landscapes around, but when it comes to breakfasts and late dinners -[b] you must be prepared to provide them with such food that they will forget food delivery exists. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9dbd00922876d4849701ac4abb378f23130be89f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/b17b85469ce20bc8eb419d3bd4b3e5e3bc0c92c3.png[/img]
Serving food to Tourists is fun, especially since you can experiment a lot, but you cannot rely fully on them for steady profit, as they only visit for some time. [b]You will have to, sooner or later, also cater to the usual residents of the city, them being Elders, Hipsters, Bluecollars, Kids, Teenagers and of course Normies. [/b]In the many Housing Districts around Boulderville you can find different groups of customers depending not only the location itself but also time of day, so be sure to adapt accordingly! Some Villas can be found around the premises as well, so you can maybe try to cater to a more ‘’expensive’’ crowd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/96f586daafefb048a5b8277e347ee030e52c24fd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f8b9fc7cb9944f4a8bc823752a2ea4fa21123bba.png[/img]
Every respected city needs to have a school. In the Clark’s Valley, you can find the [b]Boulderville Primary School with the adjoined facilities such as a Swimming Pool and a sport Court[/b]. Obviously, the customers you want to target the most is Kids with their Normies parents as a close second. One thing to note is that no kid will be seen here after school, so there’s no point leaving your truck in there for the evening unless there is an event happening at the Court or Swimming Pool. [i]Otherwise, that would be kind of weird… [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/7452099646dcef2bcfaebbeea0b4c5edf88e96f6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/866f9c41c7309b179de41758a03674837037c43e.png[/img]
You know now where different people live, but where do they spend their work and free time? Well, [b]Main Street is one of the most popular destinations for locals, so it’s less about finding the right people and more about the right time. [/b] In the morning, you will usually meet either Normies running errands and commuting to work with or Elders. The afternoon, when the majority of locals work, is a perfect time for Tourists to explore the city and try some local cuisine, but also for Teenagers starting to leave school for the day. The evening there is usually for Hipsters, because you know… [i]hipsters.[/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/e32bcfebfbc2b75fbf52cf450ebfbc0078819081.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/10d4b97a4a200460156a3c6edb74b3279447bf5e.png[/img]
[b]Clark's Valley wouldn’t be complete without a Cafe! [/b]Loved by everyone, but especially Tourists, Normies and Elders, the Whispering Willow Cafe is a perfect place for you to set up your truck and maybe grill some burgers nearby. By choosing an already established business site, you ensure that at least some people will show up, making it a pretty safe option for a first spot.[b] Who wouldn’t want a freshly prepared cheap bite with their morning coffee or tea?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/cd37940f64f25adc39d992ded7cc030be89feb12.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/639c0ffd5e4993dec9dd54b79de9d4d0d3ab5ddc.png[/img]
Some lots in Food Truck Empire are not the most visited for the time being, such as [b]Calm Forest[/b]. It may happen that in your playthrough, these may transform later to other environments as time passes but also can be hubs for special events. Nevertheless, some people appreciate the quaint nature of places like that, [b]so you can find some hungry customers there for sure in your downtime. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/f376a73ef160481d4e7192d294e6e0c4da8c1483.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/0fadac882b247c7e722c89aab9064030625fc695.png[/img]
[b]Serenity Sawmill is the usual place of work for the Bluecollars in Clark’s Valley [/b], so you will have to mostly cater to their needs and also adapt to their schedules. When they go to work, when they start they break, when they leave - [b]you have to be there to provide if you want your food truck business to prosper. [/b]Also, there is a Parking Lot nearby with the possibility of other customers appearing throughout the day, so prepare accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/9cc578e3772c46397b15662ce406112da2584b2b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41968945/49603a14ef3c16fc93d0e53721d57989090501b1.png[/img]

[h3] We hope this little guide to Clark’s Valley in Boulderville will help you once you will be able to play through the first few hours of Food Truck Empire! [/h3]
